QUITCLAIM DEED

THE GRANTOR, Rosalind Amara Ferreira, an unmarried person, for and in consideration of the termination of a community property interest and other good and valuable consideration, conveys and quitclaims to THE GRANTEE, Teodoro Emilio Ferreira, a single person, all right, title, and interest that the Grantor may have in the following described real property situated in the County of King, State of Washington:

LOT 14, BLOCK 3, MAPLEHURST ADDITION TO THE CITY OF SEATTLE, ACCORDING TO THE PLAT THEREOF RECORDED IN VOLUME 42 OF PLATS, PAGE 19, RECORDS OF KING COUNTY, WASHINGTON.

Commonly known as 3418 Maplehurst Avenue North, Seattle, Washington 98103.

This conveyance is made without any covenant of title, express or implied. The Grantor makes no warranty of any kind and conveys only such interest as the Grantor may hold on the date of this deed.

This conveyance is exempt from the real estate excise tax under WAC 458-61A-203 as a transfer incident to the dissolution of marriage, pursuant to the Decree of Dissolution entered in King County Superior Court Cause No. 25-3-01882-4 SEA on February 9, 2026.

Dated: March 6, 2026

/s/ Rosalind Amara Ferreira
Rosalind Amara Ferreira, Grantor

STATE OF WASHINGTON, COUNTY OF KING

I certify that I know or have satisfactory evidence that Rosalind Amara Ferreira is the person who appeared before me, and said person acknowledged that she signed this instrument and acknowledged it to be her free and voluntary act for the uses and purposes mentioned in the instrument.
